name: What should I figure out first before starting a multi-room interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I figure out first before starting a multi-room interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by defining which rooms must work together, what problems you want solved, and how long you plan to stay in the home. For a multi-room renovation, the right sequence depends on shared systems, traffic flow, and whether you want one cohesive design or a phased approach. In Denver-area homes, that planning step matters because adjacent rooms can affect layout, materials, and scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define the rooms, the problems you want solved, your budget, and how the spaces need to work together. That gives the project a clear scope and helps the remodel stay cohesive.
